body:
@kapunahelewong : Can I get a status on this, or whether someone should take it on? 

The fix seems to be a note or warning. Something about this being wrong: "the natural way of doing the hero tutorial is adding the crisis-center module with the crisis-center routing using the angular-cli after the app module." The problem is that it adds the crisis-center module AFTER rather than BEFORE the `AppRoutingModule`. Is this a bug in the Hero Tutorial as well?
